versions.changelog:
Initial release of the indeed-search skill.

- Search Indeed job postings by keyword and location using RolesAPI.com.
- Filter results to postings from today, this week, or remote-only, across 60+ country editions.
- Provides job listings as structured JSON output.
- Includes scripts for synchronous single-page queries and bulk retrieval (up to 3 pages).
- Requires a RolesAPI key for access; free plan available.
- Clarifies when the skill should or should not be used.
